The observed side effects of Aliskiren, such as Inflammatory Myopathy, are linked to Valsartan and Lercanidipine, both of which are used to treat hypertension. The final scores indicate a moderate level of support for this relationship, though the evidence is not strong enough to definitively establish a causal link. The mechanism of action of Aliskiren, through RAAS inhibition, is complementary to the therapeutic effects of these drugs, suggesting a possible role in blood pressure management. However, the evidence remains limited and requires further validation to support a clinical repurposing.
